## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2020-11-17: Business combination of CF Finance Acquisition Corp. IV with Grosvenor Capital Management Holdings, LLLP closes; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the November 23, 2020 8-K
- 2026-03: FY2025 10-K records TRA liability of $54.6M and cumulative cash payments to TRA Parties of $3.8M (2025) and $3.2M (2024)

## Explanation

GCM Grosvenor's TRA originated at the November 17, 2020 close of its Up-C SPAC business combination with CF Finance Acquisition Corp. IV, obligating the public company to pay 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to the GCMH Equityholders (the TRA Parties). Covered attributes are Section 754 basis step-ups from acquisitions of GCMH common units, certain pre-existing GCMH asset basis, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments themselves. The contract has not been amended, restated, or terminated; references to "Amendment No. 7" and "Amendment No. 8" in later 8-Ks pertain to the GCMH Credit Agreement, not the TRA. Liability stood at $54.6M at year-end 2025 with cash payments of $3.8M that year. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
